headline: Stocks in News: IGIL, IHCL, KEI, M&MFIN, NHPC, Alkem
summary: IGIL rallies on strong Q2 earnings while KEI drops despite profit growth. NHPC gains on new unit operation, and Alkem reshuffles leadership.

headline: Krsnaa Diagnostics partners with AZmed for AI radiology
summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics announces a strategic collaboration with AZmed to evaluate AI solutions for fracture detection, aiming to enhance reporting efficiency across its 5 million annual X-ray operations.

headline: LIC increases stake in NTPC to 7.004%
summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India acquired 2.002% of NTPC shares, raising its total holding to 7.004%. The acquisition involved 19.41 crore shares via market purchase.

headline: HDFC MF raises Havells stake to 5.012%
summary: HDFC Mutual Fund increased its holding in Havells India to 5.012% via open market purchases, crossing the significant shareholder threshold.

headline: ORSL signs MoU with MGL for CBG projects
summary: Organic Recycling Systems Ltd enters non-binding MoU with Mahanagar Gas to explore Compressed Biogas opportunities in Maharashtra and Karnataka.

headline: India Max raises stake in Liqvd Digital to 9.23%
summary: India Max Investment Fund acquired 7,04,000 shares of Liqvd Digital India Ltd on Oct 19, taking total holding to 20,54,000 shares or 9.23% of capital.

headline: Nomura initiates Buy on Hindalco, target ₹1,100
summary: Nomura has initiated coverage on Hindalco Industries with a Buy rating and a target price of ₹1,100, citing underappreciated value in the company's expansion projects.

headline: HSBC cuts M&M Financial target to ₹340
summary: HSBC maintains Buy but cuts target to ₹340 on lower valuation. Nomura and Citi also retain Buy ratings with higher targets, citing Q2 beats driven by fee income and stable asset quality.

headline: Vishal Mega Mart targets 2,000 stores
summary: Vishal Mega Mart plans to open over 100 stores annually, aiming for 2,000 large stores. The company expects EBITDA margins to rise 30 bps yearly as growth outpaces cost inflation.

headline: RBL Bank eyes broking and asset management entry
summary: RBL Bank is evaluating a foray into broking and asset management as part of its strategy to expand capital market activities.

headline: Kitara PIIN 2401 lifts Apollo Pipes stake to 8.35%
summary: Kitara PIIN 2401 acquired 20 lakh shares of Apollo Pipes via warrant conversion, raising its holding with PACs to 8.35% from 4.01%.

headline: India rupee opens at 84.47 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 84.47 against the US dollar, marginally weaker compared to the previous close of 84.46, reflecting a minor depreciation in the domestic currency.

headline: Provigil wins Bank of Maharashtra e-surveillance deal
summary: Magellanic Cloud's subsidiary Provigil Surveillance Limited has won Bank of Maharashtra's e-surveillance tender worth ₹115 crore, covering over 1,550 sites.

headline: Eternal shares worth ₹168 crore change hands
summary: A large-trade signal flagged Eternal shares across NSE and BSE. Combined value near ₹168 crore at prices around ₹315. Exchange confirmation pending post-close.

headline: NDTV adopts Amagi AdFlow for CTV
summary: NDTV has adopted Amagi's AdFlow Orchestrator to optimize ad breaks on FAST and Connected TV platforms, aiming to boost monetization and viewer retention.

headline: BPCL block trade worth ₹83.05 crore on NSE
summary: Bharat Petroleum saw a block trade of ₹83.05 crore involving ~29.98 lakh shares at ₹277.00 each on the National Stock Exchange.

headline: MPCB forfeits ₹25 lakh bank guarantee of Garware Hi-Tech
summary: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board forfeited a ₹25 lakh bank guarantee from Garware Hi-Tech Films citing alleged non-compliance. The company states the impact is limited to the encashment value with no operational disruption.

headline: Gujarat Inject Kerala board to meet Oct 26
summary: Gujarat Inject Kerala Limited scheduled a board meeting for October 26, 2026, to consider preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants.

headline: Indian Hotels sees ₹41.42 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 537,987 shares of Indian Hotels Company was executed on BSE at ₹770.00 per share, aggregating to ₹41.42 crore.

headline: SVC Industries replies to BSE on SAST disclosure gaps
summary: SVC Industries clarified BSE queries regarding promoter share pledges and NDUs filed in September 2026, confirming consolidated reporting for Akhill Marketing.

headline: Aban Offshore sets AGM for Nov 16 via VC
summary: Aban Offshore, under CIRP, schedules its 39th AGM for November 16, 2026, via video conferencing. E-voting opens November 13 with a cutoff date of November 9.

headline: Divis Laboratories shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,13,394 shares of Divis Laboratories on NSE at ₹9,128.50, with a combined value of ₹194.80 crore.

headline: Paisalo Digital Q2FY27 PAT up 28% to ₹650.5 lakh
summary: Paisalo Digital reported a 28% YoY rise in standalone net profit for Q2FY27, driven by strong interest income growth and improved asset quality metrics.

headline: Fusion CX expects three-year growth rate to sustain
summary: Fusion CX has expressed confidence that its three-year growth rate will be sustained going forward, according to a television report.

headline: Allied Blenders starts malt distillery in Telangana
summary: Allied Blenders & Distillers commenced commercial operations at its new malt distillery in Rangapur, Telangana, with a capacity of ~4.4 million BL per annum.

headline: Balkrishna Industries signs JV deal with Pirelli
summary: Balkrishna Industries enters framework, offtake, and service agreements with Pirelli for a 50:50 joint venture to manufacture passenger car radial tyres in India.

headline: Engineers India fixes record date for interim dividend
summary: Engineers India Limited has fixed November 5, 2026, as the record date for its first interim dividend for FY27. The Board will consider the payout at its October 30 meeting.

headline: Ola Electric Rights Issue: Specific Investors Apply
summary: Ola Electric Mobility confirms applications by Motilal Oswal and Calliope Capital for 2.38 crore rights entitlements in its partly paid-up equity rights issue.

headline: Corona Remedies secures ANVISA GMP certification in Brazil
summary: Corona Remedies Ltd received GMP compliance certification from ANVISA Brazil for its OSD and hormone facilities in Ahmedabad, enhancing export readiness.

headline: Patel Chem Specialities to hold investor meet on Oct 26
summary: Patel Chem Specialities Limited will host a video conference investor meet with Phillip Capital on October 26, 2026, to discuss public domain information.

headline: Beta Q2 revenue up 37% to ₹1.37 billion
summary: Beta reported Q2 revenue of ₹1.37 billion, up from ₹1 billion YoY. Net profit rose to ₹193 million from ₹120 million in the same period last year.

headline: Patel Retail expands to Nashik with new store
summary: Patel Retail Limited finalises locations for two new stores in Ghoti and Mangaon, marking entry into Nashik district and expanding footprint to four Maharashtra districts.

headline: Jaykay Enterprises subsidiary gets CDSCO licence
summary: JK Digital, a wholly owned subsidiary of Jaykay Enterprises, received a CDSCO licence to manufacture Class C/D medical devices under Neobone and Nubone brands.

headline: JTEKT India expands CVJ capacity in Gujarat
summary: JTEKT India Ltd approved a capacity expansion for its Constant Velocity Joint line in Gujarat, targeting 2.0 million units by August 2028 to meet OEM demand.

headline: Intellect Design Arena transforms Jameel Finance Egypt
summary: Intellect Design Arena announces successful digital transformation of lending operations for Jameel Finance Egypt using its EMACH.AI platform, enhancing efficiency and credit decisioning.

headline: Maharashtra Scooters Q2 revenue rises to 2.97B rupees
summary: Maharashtra Scooters reported Q2 revenue of 2.97B rupees, up from 2.71B rupees in the same period last year, reflecting a year-on-year increase.

headline: Bhageria Industries: SAT hearing on SEBI order adjourned to Jan 2027
summary: Bhageria Industries announced that the Securities Appellate Tribunal adjourned the hearing on the challenge to the March 2023 SEBI order to January 5, 2027. The stay on the order remains in effect.

headline: Paisalo Digital seeks waiver on BSE fine
summary: Paisalo Digital's board reviewed a BSE fine for non-compliance and confirmed a waiver application is pending. The company aims to ensure future regulatory adherence.

headline: Jio Platforms IPO Day 2: Subscribed 3.74x
summary: Jio Platforms IPO sees strong demand on Day 2 with overall subscription at 3.74x. QIBs lead with 9.42x, while Retail crosses 1x mark.

headline: Paras Healthcare IPO Day 2 Update
summary: Paras Healthcare IPO sees muted demand on Day 2 with overall subscription at 0.21x. Retail leads at 1.00x, while QIB and NII segments remain largely unsubscribed.

headline: Akash Mishra appointed VP of Supply Chain at Whirlpool
summary: Akash Mishra has been appointed as Vice President of Supply Chain at Whirlpool, bringing experience from PepsiCo, Reckitt, and JSW Paints to the role.

headline: Apollo Micro Inaugurates IDL Explosives' New Silo Unit
summary: Apollo Micro Systems inaugurated IDL Explosives' 9,000 MT Bolkunda Silo Unit in West Bengal to serve major coalfields and strengthen bulk explosives capacity.

headline: Diamond Power adds CCV line for 132 kV cables
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure plans to add a new CCV line for 132 kV cables with a ₹25 crore investment, targeting commissioning by December 2027.

headline: Balkrishna Industries to host business update call
summary: Balkrishna Industries Limited will hold a conference call on October 22, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST to discuss its business update. Joint MD Rajiv Poddar and senior management will participate.

headline: Marico cuts emissions intensity 89.3% since FY13
summary: Marico Limited reported an 89.3% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions intensity compared to FY13. Renewable energy now covers 77.3% of operational consumption.

headline: NCLT approves Shyam Metalics subsidiary merger
summary: The NCLT Kolkata approved the amalgamation of Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast into Shyam Sel and Power, a wholly owned subsidiary of Shyam Metalics.

headline: Continental Controls rights issue opens Oct 23
summary: Continental Controls Limited launches a rights issue of up to 1.96 crore shares at ₹10 each, aggregating ₹196.68 lakh. The issue opens on October 23 and closes October 30, 2026.

headline: Rane Holdings invests ₹80.85 crore in ZF JV
summary: Rane Holdings approves ₹80.85 crore rights issue subscription in ZF LIFETEC Rane Automotive India to fund capex, maintaining 49% stake.

headline: Garware Hi-Tech Q2 revenue rises 23.5% YoY
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films reported Q2 revenue of ₹630 crore, up from ₹510 crore YoY. EBITDA margin expanded to 22.76%, though net profit declined to ₹140 crore.

headline: SRF targets 15-20% chemical revenue growth by FY27
summary: SRF aims for 15-20% revenue growth in its chemical operations by FY27. The company secured regulatory approvals for its HFO project in Gopalpur, targeting commissioning in Q4FY28.

headline: PFC incorporates new subsidiary for Northern Grid transmission
summary: Power Finance Corporation incorporated Northern Region Power Transmission Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to manage preparatory activities for transmission projects in the Northern Region.

headline: Grauer & Weil Q2 net profit rises to 1.4B rupees YoY
summary: Grauer & Weil reported a net profit of 1.4B rupees in Q2, up from 1.06B rupees in the same period last year, reflecting a YoY improvement in profitability.

headline: Bansal Wire Q2 Results: EBITDA up, margin expands
summary: Bansal Wire Industries reported Q2 EBITDA of 1.04B rupees, up from 768M a year ago, with EBITDA margin expanding to 8% from 7.3% YoY.

headline: Aurionpro and Mastercard partner on transit payments
summary: Aurionpro Solutions and Mastercard have partnered to bring contactless payment solutions to public transportation networks across North America.

headline: Allcargo seeks shareholder nod for Vijay Nehra as MD & CEO
summary: Allcargo Logistics Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking member approval to appoint Vijay Nehra as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer for a five-year term starting January 1, 2027.

headline: JSW Energy to raise funds via NCDs, equity
summary: JSW Energy Ltd board meets Oct 28, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 results and long-term fund raising through debentures and securities.

headline: KEI Industries guides on EPC losses and Sanand ramp-up
summary: KEI Industries expects ₹5-7 crore EBIT loss from winding down EPC operations. Sanand plant revenue run rate targeted to rise to ₹250-300 crore in Q3.

headline: PropShare Platina signs term sheet for ₹410 crore asset sale
summary: PropShare Platina executed a non-binding term sheet to sell all assets for an enterprise value of ₹410.13 crore to an AIF. The deal involves transferring share capital of SPVs.

headline: Reliance Comms seeks AGM extension due to CIRP
summary: Reliance Communications Ltd has filed for an extension to convene its FY26 AGM, citing prolonged corporate insolvency proceedings and operational constraints.

headline: J&K Bank Q2 net profit rises 12% YoY to ₹5.5B
summary: J&K Bank reported Q2 net profit of ₹5.5B, beating estimates of ₹5.1B. Asset quality improved with GNPA falling to 2.23% and NNPA to 0.51% QoQ.

headline: Sapphire Q2 EBITDA rises to ₹1.3B
summary: Sapphire reported Q2 revenue of ₹8.9B, up from ₹7.4B YoY. EBITDA rose to ₹1.3B with margins expanding to 14.3%.

headline: Kopran clears EU GMP inspection with no critical observations
summary: Kopran Ltd successfully concluded the EU GMP inspection at its Khopoli formulation facility. The audit ended with zero critical or data integrity findings, though one major observation was noted.

headline: Ramgopal Polytex open offer sees minimal acceptance
summary: Ramgopal Polytex open offer by Shishodiya brothers accepted only 208 shares against 37.7 lakh proposed, with consideration paid at ₹17.10 per share.

headline: Nidhi Granites acquires stake in Jowela Exim
summary: Nidhi Granites acquired 16 lakh equity shares of Jowela Exim Private Limited via rights issue, making it a subsidiary. Allotment dated October 15, 2026.

headline: BN Agrochem adjourns EGM due to lack of quorum
summary: BN Agrochem Limited adjourned its first Extra-Ordinary General Meeting for FY27 due to lack of quorum. The meeting will reconvene on October 29, 2026.

headline: Natco Pharma rights issue closes today
summary: Natco Pharma Ltd has closed its ₹12,794 million rights issue period on October 22, 2026. The issue opened on October 12, 2026, offering shares at ₹750 each.

headline: Rajratan Global Wire targets 60,000 TPA capacity by Q3FY27
summary: Rajratan Global Wire plans to expand production capacity to 60,000 tonnes annually by Q3FY27. The Chennai expansion Phase 1 is nearly fully utilized, supporting regional and global market growth.

headline: Sangita cuts stake in Laser Diamonds to 9.64%
summary: Sangita disposed of a 13.50% stake in Laser Diamonds Limited via off-market sale on October 14, 2026, reducing her holding from 23.14% to 9.64%.

headline: Kiran Kumar Jain sells 2.69% stake in Raj TV
summary: Kiran Kumar Jain M. sold 13,97,861 shares of Raj Television Network Ltd via open market, reducing his holding to 6.909%. The disposal occurred on October 22, 2026.

headline: J&K Bank discloses ₹82.51 crore related party transactions
summary: Jammu and Kashmir Bank reported ₹82.51 crore in related party transactions for H1FY27, dominated by interest paid to associate J&K Grameen Bank.

headline: Indobell Insulations exempt from RPT disclosures
summary: Indobell Insulations Ltd declared non-applicability of Related Party Transaction disclosures for H1FY26 due to SME listing exemptions based on net worth limits.

headline: Chennai Petroleum Q2 net profit rises to ₹23B
summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd reported Q2 net profit of ₹23 billion, up from ₹10 billion in the previous quarter. EBITDA margin expanded to 14.5% despite a decline in revenue.

headline: Royal Sandur MedTech leases 6.2 acres at AMTZ
summary: Sandur Manganese subsidiary secures 33-year lease at Visakhapatnam MedTech Zone to launch medical devices manufacturing unit.

headline: GMDC appoints IIM-A professor as independent director
summary: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation appoints Prof. Amit Karna as Additional Independent Director and Audit Committee member, effective October 21, 2026.

headline: Wiscon Industries IPO: ₹196 Cr Revenue; BIS Risk
summary: Wiscon Industries files DRHP for SME IPO. Revenue surged to ₹196.87 Cr in FY26. Key risks include BIS non-compliance and high supplier concentration.

summary: Carver Roboweld Limited files DRHP for SME IPO. Plans to raise funds to expand welding robot fleet from 12 to 39 units and repay debt. Revenue grew to ₹27.02 Cr in FY2026.

headline: Bharat Coking Coal board meeting postponed to Oct 25
summary: Bharat Coking Coal Ltd postponed its 448th board meeting from October 24 to October 25, 2026. The meeting will review Q2FY26 standalone financial results.

headline: Havells Q2 net profit rises to ₹3.53 billion
summary: Havells India reported a 11.4% YoY rise in net profit to ₹3.53 billion for Q2, beating estimates. Revenue surged 34.2% to ₹64 billion.

headline: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO DRHP
summary: BCSSL files DRHP for ₹125 crore debt repayment and equipment acquisition. Revenue grew to ₹1,266.82 crore in FY26 with strong capacity expansion.

headline: NAM-INDIA Q2 EBITDA rises to ₹5.4B
summary: NAM-INDIA reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹5.4 billion, up from ₹4.3 billion YoY. Revenue grew to ₹8 billion, with margins expanding to 67.54%.

headline: Netripples Q4FY19 Results: Net profit rises 109% YoY
summary: Netripples Software Ltd reported a net profit of ₹12.72 lakh for Q4FY19, up 109% YoY. Revenue from operations grew 68% YoY to ₹449.51 lakh.

headline: Nippon Life India AMC Q2FY27 Results
summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management reports Q2FY27 net profit of ₹324 crore, down 6% YoY due to exceptional items, while operating profit rises 25%. Interim dividend declared.

headline: Unitech extends Ashok Kumar Yadav's CEO tenure
summary: Unitech Limited has extended the tenure of Ashok Kumar Yadav, IAS (Retd.), as CEO for two years until February 2029. The board approved this on October 22, 2026.

headline: Bombay HC rejects tax dept notice against Grasim Industries
summary: The Bombay High Court has rejected a tax department notice seeking to reassess the income of Grasim Industries, ruling in favour of the company.

headline: Tinna Rubber Q2 Revenue Up 34% YoY
summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure reports Q2 revenue of ₹160 crore, up 34.5% YoY. Net profit rose 44% to ₹17 crore with EBITDA margin at 18.8%.

headline: KSH International gets Power Grid approval for transformers
summary: KSH International has received approval from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited to manufacture CTC, PICC, and BPICC for transformers and reactors up to 765 KV class.

headline: Sayaji Industries Q2FY27 profit turns positive
summary: Sayaji Industries reported a net profit of ₹390.75 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the prior year. Revenue rose 7.1% YoY to ₹25,618.60 lakh.

headline: Shakti Pumps invests ₹12 crore in EV subsidiary
summary: Shakti Pumps subscribed to equity shares of Shakti EV Mobility, raising consolidated investment to ₹92 crore. The subsidiary reported turnover of ₹2,425.41 lakh in FY26.

headline: Adani Energy Solutions Q2 net profit up 147% to ₹13.2B
summary: Adani Energy Solutions reported a 53% YoY rise in Q2 revenue to ₹101B and a 147% jump in net profit to ₹13.2B, beating analyst estimates.

headline: Anantam Highways Trust Q2FY27: Declares ₹2.75/unit distribution
summary: Anantam Highways Trust approved Q2FY27 results and declared a distribution of ₹2.75 per unit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The payout includes interest, dividend, and capital repayment components.

headline: Gujarat Alkalies launches 33,870 TPA phosphoric acid plant
summary: Gujarat Alkalies & Chemicals held a ceremony to launch its 33,870 TPA phosphoric acid plant at Dahej, attended by senior leaders and engineering experts.

headline: Poojaa Precision H1FY27 profit jumps 88% to ₹249 crore
summary: Poojaa Precision Engg. Ltd reported an 88% YoY rise in PAT to ₹249 crore for H1FY27, driven by 68% revenue growth to ₹2,101 crore and improved margins.

headline: Trishakti Industries Q2FY27 Net Profit Jumps 223%
summary: Trishakti Industries reported a 223% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹518.92 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by higher operational revenue and other income.

headline: Dalmia Bharat Sugar secures $87.5M loan for Tanzania project
summary: Dalmia Bharat Sugar & Industries secured a $87.5 million loan from CRDB Bank for a sugar production project in Tanzania, with EATL planning a 3500 TCD unit and 20 MW co-generation facility.

headline: LIC of India sees ₹86.49 crore NSE block trade
summary: A block trade of approximately 2,231,652 shares of LIC of India was executed on the NSE at ₹387.55 per share, totalling ₹86.49 crore.

headline: Adani Ports incorporates Oman terminal subsidiary
summary: Adani Ports & SEZ incorporated Indian Ocean Gateway Terminal in Oman via a wholly owned subsidiary to expand its global integrated transport operations.

headline: LG Electronics India wins Great Place to Work cert
summary: LG Electronics India earned Great Place to Work certification for the third consecutive year, reflecting sustained focus on employee trust and culture.

headline: Sungold Media H1FY27 net profit rises 37.5% YoY
summary: Sungold Media & Entertainment reported a 37.5% YoY rise in H1FY27 net profit to ₹1.96 lakh, despite a 6.6% dip in revenue from operations.

headline: Zaggle sets up Abu Dhabi subsidiary
summary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services incorporated Zaggle Holding Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary in ADGM, UAE, on October 22, 2026.

headline: Ganesh Housing internal auditor resigns
summary: Ganesh Housing Limited announced the resignation of internal auditor Purnesh R. Mehta and Co. due to health issues. The company is initiating steps to appoint a replacement.

headline: Sayaji Hotels passes borrowing, RPT resolutions
summary: Sayaji Hotels (Indore) Limited passed special and ordinary resolutions via postal ballot. Key approvals included enhanced borrowing limits and material related party transactions.

headline: Trishakti Industries targets ₹1,000 crore gross block by FY30
summary: Trishakti Industries launches Mission 2030 to expand its equipment rental platform, aiming for a ₹1,000 crore cumulative gross block by FY30.

headline: JSL Industries Q2 net profit up 11.5% to ₹9 billion
summary: JSL Industries reported Q2 net profit of ₹9 billion, up from ₹8.07 billion YoY. Revenue rose to ₹129 billion, while EBITDA stood at ₹14.3 billion.

headline: Adani Total Gas Q2 net profit rises 23% QoQ
summary: Adani Total Gas reports Q2 net profit of ₹1.73 billion, up from ₹1.41 billion QoQ. Revenue climbed to ₹21 billion with EBITDA margin expanding to 15.5%.

headline: Jindal Stainless Q2FY27 PAT rises to ₹785.5 crore
summary: Jindal Stainless reported a standalone net profit of ₹785.50 crore for Q2FY27, up from ₹643.89 crore in Q2FY25. The board also approved a scheme of amalgamation with four subsidiaries.

headline: Cera Sanitaryware board to meet Nov 4 for Q2FY27 results
summary: Cera Sanitaryware Limited will hold a board meeting on November 4, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 financial results and re-appoint key directors.

headline: Futuristic Securities Q2FY27 loss widens to ₹1.51 lakh
summary: Futuristic Securities reported a net loss of ₹1.51 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹1.36 lakh in Q2FY26. Revenue remained flat at ₹1.58 lakh as other income dropped to zero.

headline: Aditya Goenka group raises HOEC stake to 8.14%
summary: Aditya Goenka and associated entities acquired 1.2 lakh shares of Hindustan Oil Exploration Company, lifting their cumulative holding to 8.14% of the share capital.

headline: Midaas Fashions activates new ISIN for stock split
summary: Midaas Fashions Limited (formerly Shentracon Chemicals) has activated a new ISIN for its equity shares following a 1:2 stock split. The record date is October 26, 2026.

headline: Tokyo Finance Q2FY27 PAT rises 98% YoY
summary: Tokyo Finance Ltd reported a 98.4% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹6.17 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by higher interest income and reduced expenses.

headline: Swiggy Q2 loss narrows to ₹9.2 billion
summary: Swiggy reported a consolidated net loss of ₹9.2 billion for Q2, narrowing from ₹10.92 billion a year ago. Revenue rose to ₹75.71 billion, missing analyst estimates.

headline: Concor appoints Anand Saklecha as independent director
summary: Container Corporation of India has appointed Anand Saklecha as a Non-Official (Independent) Director for a three-year term effective October 12, 2026.

headline: Mankind Pharma shifts Q2FY27 earnings call time
summary: Mankind Pharma reschedules its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call to 5:00 PM IST on October 26, 2026, due to unavoidable circumstances.

headline: Veedol Corp VP Manufacturing resigns effective Nov 24
summary: Veedol Corporation Ltd announced the resignation of Ranesh Sinha, Vice President – Manufacturing, citing family commitments. The cessation is effective November 24, 2026.

headline: Simandhar Impex internal auditor resigns
summary: Simandhar Impex Limited announced the resignation of internal auditor M/s V.K. Surana and Co. effective October 21, 2026, citing unavoidable circumstances.

headline: Fusion CX submits fair disclosure code
summary: Fusion CX Limited submitted its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI to stock exchanges. The code, effective April 11, 2025, ensures transparency and prevents misuse of price-sensitive information.

headline: Ghushine Fintrrade board approves H1FY27 results
summary: Ghushine Fintrrade Ocean Limited's Board approved unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting concluded on October 22, 2026.

headline: Jivial Industries board approves IPO object alteration
summary: Jivial Industries Ltd board meeting on October 22, 2026, approved alterations to IPO objects and a CFO change. Dhara Vekariya resigned; Shubham Sagpariya appointed.

headline: Swiggy retains 18-20% growth target; margin boost expected
summary: Swiggy maintains its annual food delivery growth target of 18% to 20%. The company anticipates continued high competition during the festive season, while a transition to Indian ownership is projected to improve net margins by approximately 80 basis points.

headline: Swiggy board approves re-appointment of Anand Kripalu and Suparna Mitra
summary: Swiggy Ltd's board approved the re-appointment of Anand Kripalu as Chairman and Suparna Mitra as Independent Director for five-year terms, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Mankind Pharma to host analyst meet on Oct 27
summary: Mankind Pharma will hold an in-person analyst and institutional investor meet in Mumbai on October 27, 2026. Senior management and Armed Cell Therapeutics leadership will participate.

headline: Mitsu Chem Plast approves ₹15.1 crore warrant allotment
summary: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd board approves allotment of 10 lakh fully convertible warrants at ₹151 each to promoters and a non-promoter, raising ₹3.77 crore upfront.

headline: Fire at Augmont subsidiary causes ₹2 crore loss
summary: A fire at Ideal Fiscal Services' Jaipur unit caused an estimated ₹2 crore loss. Operations are disrupted, but insurance coverage is in place.

headline: Southern Magnesium GST case closed with zero demand
summary: Southern Magnesium & Chemicals Ltd received an order from GST authorities concluding tax proceedings with zero demand. The company confirmed no financial impact on operations.

headline: Elecon Engineering eyes strong H2FY27 revenue growth
summary: Elecon Engineering Company expects strong revenue growth in H2FY27, with EBITDA margins projected to match last year's levels.

headline: National Plastic Technologies CS resigns
summary: Abishek S resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of National Plastic Technologies Ltd effective October 30, 2026, citing better career opportunities.

headline: Cyient Q2FY27: Revenue up 25%, declares ₹12 dividend
summary: Cyient reported 25% YoY revenue growth to ₹2,235 crore in Q2FY27. Net profit fell to ₹133 crore due to higher costs. Board declared an interim dividend of ₹12 per share.

headline: CPCL appoints R G N Price & Co as statutory auditors for FY27
summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited appointed M/S R G N Price & Co as statutory auditors for FY27, effective October 22, 2026. The appointment was made by the C&AG of India.

headline: Colgate Q2FY27: Net sales up 12.2%, declares ₹24 dividend
summary: Colgate-Palmolive India reported 12.2% YoY net sales growth in Q2FY27. Net profit rose to ₹342 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹24 per share.

headline: Premier Capital Services CS resigns
summary: Premier Capital Services Ltd announced the resignation of Mansi Birla as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 22, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: Fairchem Organics Q2 net profit jumps to ₹102 million
summary: Fairchem Organics reported a sharp rise in Q2 standalone net profit to ₹102 million from ₹7.7 million YoY, driven by revenue growth to ₹1.67 billion.

headline: Ashok Leyland CHRO Raja Radhakrishnan resigns
summary: Raja Radhakrishnan, Head of Special Projects and HR, has resigned from Ashok Leyland effective October 21, 2026. He offered to assist with the transition.

headline: SAIL to host analyst meet on Oct 28
summary: Steel Authority of India Ltd. schedules an analyst and institutional investor meet for October 28, 2026, to discuss Q3FY26 financial results via conference call.

headline: Shivamshree Q2FY27: Loss widens, board approves results
summary: Shivamshree Businesses reported a net loss of ₹38.20 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹3.43 lakh a year ago. Revenue fell 56% YoY to ₹185.26 lakh as trading segment revenue dropped to zero.

headline: JSW Dulux updates investor grievance email ID
summary: JSW Dulux Limited notified exchanges of a new official email address for investor grievances and shareholder correspondence, effective October 22, 2026.

headline: Mahindra CIE Q2 net profit rises to ₹2.44 billion
summary: Mahindra CIE Automotive reported Q2 net profit of ₹2.44 billion, up from ₹2.1 billion YoY and beating estimates of ₹2.35 billion. Revenue grew to ₹26.33 billion.

headline: Accelya Q2 net profit dips to ₹288.5M
summary: Accelya Solutions reported a consolidated net profit of ₹288.5 million for Q2, down from ₹296 million YoY, despite revenue growth to ₹1.38 billion.

headline: Roselabs Finance Q2FY27 Results
summary: Roselabs Finance Ltd reported a net loss of ₹6.04 lakh in Q2FY27. The company recorded zero revenue from operations for the quarter.

headline: HPCL reports lower H1 profits on margin dip
summary: HPCL reported lower profits for April-September due to reduced marketing margins. Average GRM stood at $27.89 per barrel for the period.

headline: HPCL Q2 net profit turns positive at ₹36.25B
summary: Hindustan Petroleum posted a net profit of ₹36.25 billion in Q2, reversing a prior loss of ₹122.64 billion. EBITDA swung to a gain of ₹95.2 billion from a loss.

headline: Raymond updates Minerva Ventures stake to 4.31%
summary: Raymond Limited revised Minerva Ventures Fund's post-preferential issue holding to 4.31% on a fully diluted basis, down from the initially disclosed 4.35%.

headline: CIE Automotive Q3 CY26: Revenue up 11%, EBITDA steady
summary: CIE Automotive India reported 11% YoY revenue growth to ₹25,585 million in Q3 CY26. EBITDA rose 11% to ₹4,178 million, with margins holding at 16.3%.

headline: Vibhor Steel grants ₹5 crore loan to subsidiary
summary: Vibhor Steel Tubes approved a ₹5 crore unsecured loan to wholly owned subsidiary Viyom Steel Infra for working capital and infrastructure manufacturing expansion.

headline: Kotyark Industries submits board comments on NSE, BSE fines
summary: Kotyark Industries submitted board comments to NSE and BSE regarding fines for delayed Q1FY27 results. The delay was attributed to auditor transition issues.

headline: Creative Eye CFO resigns; board approves ₹15.98 crore debt
summary: Creative Eye Limited CFO Sachin Devare resigned effective November 14, 2026. The board also approved an overdraft facility and a loan against property totaling ₹15.98 crore for business operations.

headline: Varvee Global Q2FY27 Results: Net profit falls 33% YoY
summary: Varvee Global Ltd reported a net profit of ₹678.91 lakh for Q2FY27, down 33.5% YoY. Revenue from operations fell 29.5% to ₹1,960.77 lakh, while other income surged to ₹806.90 lakh.

headline: Megri Soft Q2FY27: Net profit up 108% YoY
summary: Megri Soft Limited reported a standalone net profit of ₹28.96 lakh for Q2FY27, marking a 107.4% year-on-year increase. Revenue from operations grew 71.5% YoY to ₹90.55 lakh.

headline: Afcons certifies no CP issued in Q2FY27
summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited confirmed it did not issue any Commercial Paper during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, adhering to SEBI listing conditions.

headline: Ugro Capital scheme hearing set for Nov 20
summary: Ugro Capital Limited received intimation that the final hearing for its amalgamation with Profectus Capital Private Limited is scheduled for November 20, 2026.

headline: Fusion CX appoints KFin Technologies as RTA
summary: Fusion CX Limited has appointed KFin Technologies Limited as its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent. The appointment complies with SEBI Listing Regulations for investor servicing.

headline: Indo Thai Q2FY27: Net loss widens to ₹3,558 lakh
summary: Indo Thai Securities reported a standalone net loss of ₹3,558.48 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing from a profit of ₹1,460.88 lakh in Q2FY26. The swing was driven by a net fair value loss of ₹4,610.37 lakh.

headline: Fusion CX appoints Barun Singh as Compliance Officer
summary: Fusion CX Limited confirmed Barun Singh continues as Compliance Officer effective March 28, 2025. He also oversees insider trading compliance and the Structured Digital Database.

headline: CreditAccess Grameen Q2FY27: PAT jumps 298% YoY
summary: CreditAccess Grameen reported a net profit of ₹501.57 crore for Q2FY27, a 298% YoY rise. Revenue from operations grew 26.2% YoY to ₹1,903.74 crore.

headline: Jindal Saw to host investor meet with Equirus
summary: Jindal Saw Ltd will hold a physical investor meeting with Equirus Securities in New Delhi on October 27, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Sky Gold and Diamonds plans to raise funds via securities
summary: Sky Gold and Diamonds has announced plans to raise funds through eligible securities, signalling a capital-raising initiative by the company.

headline: ABREL seeks shareholder nod for ₹124 crore ESOP scheme
summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited proposes a new ESOP scheme for 8.29 lakh shares, funded by a ₹124 crore interest-free loan to its employee welfare trust.

headline: Skyline Millars Q2FY27: Turns profitable, revenue falls
summary: Skyline Millars reported a net profit of ₹5.02 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing a loss. Revenue from operations declined 28% YoY to ₹50.19 lakh.

headline: BSE clears promoter reclassification for Healthy Investments
summary: BSE granted no-objection for reclassifying three promoters to public category. All three hold zero shares, exempting the company from shareholder approval requirements.

headline: CreditAccess Grameen updates FY27 targets
summary: CreditAccess Grameen has revised its FY27 goals, projecting a net interest margin of 14.4%-14.7% and return on equity of 21%-24%.

headline: Continental Petroleums Q2FY27 Results
summary: Continental Petroleums Ltd reported a 20% YoY decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹86.42 lakh. Revenue rose 2.3% YoY, but H1 profits fell due to higher finance costs.

headline: Anka India gets NCLT nod for Futech merger
summary: NCLT New Delhi sanctioned the amalgamation of subsidiary Futech Internet Private Limited with Anka India Ltd. The scheme has an appointed date of April 1, 2025.

headline: Cyient buys remaining 49% in UAV subsidiary
summary: Cyient acquires the remaining 49% stake in Cyient Solutions and Systems Private Limited for ₹1,00,000, making it a wholly owned subsidiary focused on unmanned aerial systems.

headline: Hatsun Agro Q2FY27: Profit up 5.6% YoY
summary: Hatsun Agro Product Ltd reported a 5.6% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹115.69 crore, despite a 6.2% QoQ decline in revenue.

headline: Redington Gulf signs strategic AI pact with AWS
summary: Redington Gulf signed a strategic collaboration agreement with AWS to accelerate AI adoption in the META region, leveraging six AWS competencies to drive cloud modernization.

headline: Indo Thai Securities reports no fund deviation
summary: Indo Thai Securities Limited reported no deviation in the utilization of ₹12.07 crore raised via preferential warrants for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: JMJ Fintech board approves ₹7 crore NCD issue
summary: JMJ Fintech Ltd board approved a ₹7 crore private placement of unlisted NCDs, director re-designations, and increased related-party loan limits.

headline: Rallis Q2 EBITDA falls to ₹140 crore
summary: Rallis India Q2 EBITDA declined to ₹140 crore from ₹154 crore YoY. Net profit stood at ₹85 crore, beating the ₹75.1 crore estimate.

headline: Aeroflex Neu passes key resolutions at EGM
summary: Aeroflex Neu Ltd members approved alterations to the object clause and material related party transactions during its EGM held on October 22, 2026.

headline: NACL Industries seeks approval for ₹550 crore related party deal
summary: NACL Industries Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for a Letter of Comfort arrangement with Coromandel International Limited valued at up to ₹550 crore.

headline: Amit Securities director Pradeep Kumar Sharma completes tenure
summary: Pradeep Kumar Sharma, DIN 09296525, informed Amit Securities Ltd that his tenure as Independent Director concluded on October 22, 2026. He requested the Board to communicate this to ROC and BSE.

headline: Hitech Corp delisting offer remains successful after corrigendum
summary: Hitech Corporation Limited issued a corrigendum to its reverse book building outcome. Despite a minor adjustment in valid tendered shares, the delisting offer continues to be successful with promoter holding at 91.96%.

headline: J&K Bank Q2FY27: Net profit up 29% QoQ
summary: Jammu and Kashmir Bank reported a 29% sequential jump in net profit to ₹546 crore for Q2FY27. Asset quality hit decadal bests with GNPA at 2.23%, while NIM compressed to 3.22%.

headline: Yarn Syndicate board to decide on share forfeiture
summary: Yarn Syndicate Limited's board will meet on October 27, 2026, to consider forfeiture notices for unpaid call money on partly paid-up equity shares from the 2024 rights issue.

headline: Petronet LNG to set up 10 CBG plants via JV
summary: Petronet LNG signs binding term sheet with Gruner Renewable Energy for a 50:50 JV to build 10 CBG plants. The project involves an estimated capital outlay of ₹1,200 crore.
